title: Preventive Arterial Wall Phenotype and Low-dose Fluvastatin/Valsartan Combination

sections.abstract: The study was designed to test whether short-term treatment with a very low-dose combination of fluvastatin and valsartan could induce improvement of endothelial function, arterial stiffness, vascular inflammation, oxidative stress and expression of protective genes in subjects with moderate cardiovascular risk.
